name: Druid Blue-Clad Druid
body:
Where Nature has been despoiled and needs to be restored, where conflict rampages and peace is nowhere to be found, where horrid gates link the land to planes of horror and evil taints the living, where countries destroyed by war and pestilence have to be reconstructed, blue-clad druids appear as counselors and saviors, perhaps sent by Nature itself to heal the world’s wounds. Pacifists at heart, they fight through example and care rather than weapons and violence, teaching men and animals alike how to reconcile their differences in order to survive and thrive again.

Life Sense (Ex)

A blue-clad druid gains a +2 bonus on Heal, Knowledge (nature), and Survival checks. This replaces nature sense.

Nature Bond (Ex)

In addition to the domains normally available to a druid, a blue-clad druid may select Charm, Healing, and Community.

Spontaneous Casting: A blue-clad druid can spontaneously cast cure spells as well as summon nature’s ally spells. This replaces the druid’s normal spontaneous casting ability.

Universal Empathy (Su)

A blue-clad druid adds her druid level and her Charisma modifier to all Diplomacy checks. This replaces wild empathy.
